text:
You need an application that uses OpenAI, Eleven Labs, and hosted Stable Diffusion APIs to generate sales copy and build a webpage for customers.

I’m Noor Halden, and I build AI applications with Python and machine learning. In a legal project, I built a contract clause search assistant that answered questions over 9,000 contracts and always quoted the clause and page it used, reaching 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set. In logistics, I built a WhatsApp and SMS delivery support chatbot that tracked parcels, rescheduled deliveries, and handed off to a human with full context; 43% of conversations were resolved without an agent.

I have 6 years of experience with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. I’d be glad to discuss the full scope and build something long term with your team.
